title: `--INI--` parses and nothing can act on it.
text: Parsing it is what keeps the M11 importer mechanical; the section is recorded as unsupported (`case`'s `NOT_YET` roster) and a case that uses it is reported as a **failure** naming the reason, never run-and-half-ignored. What is missing is not the configuration, which is read, but anything that turns an INI key into the configuration a case's program runs under — and the reason `NOT_YET` prints still names M6, a milestone that has since walked, so that string changes with it.
